rationale.consistency: Follows v6 patterns for 409 fallback and CheckResponse, but uses pointer ResponseError vs v6 value type, fmt.Errorf without verbs, package named `test`, and drops the existing //nolint:gosec on the VU cast.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles 409, missing upload URL, aborted/completed while polling, ctx cancellation and bad durations; but resolveDefaultProjectID is now called unconditionally (may ignore an explicit ProjectID) and StackID is passed to SetStackID even when unset.
rationale.scope: Core flow delivered, but carries dead weight: unused apiClient/token/timeout fields and SDK config in provisioning.Client, unreachable trailing returns, an extra clientcfg package and setters (SetMetricsURL/SetMetricsHTTPClient) not used by production code.
rationale.readability: Orchestration in provision.go is clear; StartLocalExecution has six near-identical nullable-unwrap blocks and two hand-rolled retry loops that obscure intent.
rationale.robustness: Bodies closed, retries bounded, notify has a timeout fallback, no auth leaked to presigned PUT; retry logic duplicated in UploadArchive and HTTPClient.Do risks divergence, and the output builds a full v6-backed client just to notify.
rationale.maintainability: Token/host fallback logic repeated in cmd layer and output; output re-derives clients from JSON-serialized config rather than receiving them, creating hidden coupling; duplicated retry code.
